title: PACD: Provenance-Aware Consensus Decoding for Mitigating Cross-Modal Hallucinations in Omnimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.22456v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) integrate audio, video, and text for multimodal reasoning, yet remain vulnerable to cross-modal hallucinations, where one modality improperly influences predictions about another. Existing training-free decoding methods mitigate these errors through modality perturbation or relevance-based weighting. However, due to interference from irrelevant modality cues during fusion and difficulty detecting shared errors, these methods may suppress correct unimodal predictions and allow erroneous consensus to persist. To address these limitations, we propose Provenance-Aware Consensus Decoding (PACD), a training-free framework for mitigating cross-modal hallucinations. PACD comprises two complementary paths based on whether the branches reach consensus. For non-consensus cases, Relevance-Guided Candidate Arbitration identifies task-relevant unimodal evidence and selectively arbitrates between predictions

translated_title: PACD：面向全模态大语言模型跨模态幻觉缓解的溯源感知共识解码
translated_abstract: 全模态大语言模型整合音频、视频和文本进行多模态推理，但仍然容易受到跨模态幻觉的影响，即一种模态不当地影响对另一种模态的预测。现有的免训练解码方法通过模态扰动或基于相关性的加权来缓解这些错误。然而，由于融合过程中无关模态线索的干扰以及难以检测共享错误，这些方法可能会抑制正确的单模态预测，并使错误的共识持续存在。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了溯源感知共识解码（PACD），这是一个用于缓解跨模态幻觉的免训练框架。PACD根据各分支是否达成共识，包含两条互补的路径。对于非共识情况，相关性引导的候选仲裁会识别与任务相关的单模态证据，并在各预测之间选择性地进行仲裁
tldr: 提出了一种免训练的溯源感知共识解码框架PACD，根据模态分支间是否达成共识采用两条互补路径（如相关性引导的候选仲裁），有效缓解全模态大语言模型中的跨模态幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: PACD, a training-free provenance-aware consensus decoding framework that mitigates cross-modal hallucinations in omnimodal LLMs by following two complementary paths based on whether modality branches reach consensus, such as relevance-guided candidate arbitration for non-consensus cases.
